title: Write unit tests for slugify
description: `slugify.py` is correct, but it has no tests. Write a thorough unittest suite in `test_slugify.py` (create the file). Your tests will be run against the correct implementation (they must all pass) and then against several subtly broken versions of `slugify` (they must detect every one of them). Cover every documented behaviour and its edge cases. Write at least 6 tests.

mutants.description: does not strip accents (café becomes caf)
leaves a trailing separator after truncation
accepts None instead of raising TypeError
